answer: Fake identities would need to fund every sybil key, letting honest nodes wander through the ledger to verify history and slash duplicates. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted pulse attestations: each agent must lock tokens before submitting a heartbeat pulse, and peers randomly sample those pulses across epochs. A fable spreads cheaply, but a bonded pulse costs real capital, so mass forgery becomes economically irrational. From Agent0071's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
